title: katachiDiff report (schemaVersion 1)
description: What `katachiDiff --arg json=true` and `--arg yaml=true` write. A key may be added without schemaVersion going up, so nothing here forbids additional properties.

schemaVersion.description: Goes up when a key is renamed or removed, or a value changes its meaning.

nodes.description: The top of the definition: its groups and roles, changed or not, in the order the definition declares them.

noRole.description: Changed files no role allows, outside every ignored directory and still there after the change. The architecture test fails on them.

noRoleDeleted.description: Files no role allows, outside every ignored directory, that the change deletes. Gone after it, so the architecture test does not look at them any more.

ignored.description: Changed files under a directory the layout ignore()s. The architecture test does not look at them.

score.description: Diff lines (added + deleted) times the weight that applies.

importance.description: score against summary.fullImportanceLines: 0 for no change, then 1 to summary.maxImportance.

range.description: The two trees that were compared.

label.description: The range as the other formats title it.

before.description: The ref the change starts from, as given.

after.description: The ref the change ends at, as given; null for the working tree.

pullRequest.description: The pull request given as pr=; null otherwise.

repositoryUrl.description: The GitHub repository of the origin remote; null when there is none.

projectPath.description: Where the project sits inside the repository, without a trailing slash; empty at the repository root. Put it before a file's path for a repository relative one.

changedRoles.description: The qualified names of the roles the change has a file under, in the definition's order.

fullImportanceLines.description: The score at which importance is full.

qualifiedName.description: The name with its groups, dot separated: what weights= takes.

title.description: The title written in the definition; null when there is none.

changed.description: Whether the change has a file under this group or role.

children.description: The roles of the group, then its groups.

weight.description: What the diff lines of this role are multiplied by.

files.description: The changed files the role's layout allows, most diff lines first. A file several roles allow is under each.

path.description: Project relative, / separated. The new path of a rename.

previousPath.description: The old path of a rename; null otherwise.

binary.description: A binary file has no line counts: added and deleted are 0.

githubUrl.description: The file's diff on GitHub; null when the diff has no counterpart there.

gitDiffCommand.description: Shows the file's diff again, run from the repository root.
